go_id.description: Gene Ontology identifier in GO:NNNNNNN format. Specifies the biological function, process, or component used to retrieve associated UniProt sequences. Use literature_search or interpro_sequences to discover the right GO ID before calling this tool.

aspect.description: GO aspect filter. Use `molecular_function` (or `mf`) for catalytic/binding roles, `biological_process` (or `bp`) for pathways, `cellular_component` (or `cc`) for subcellular localization. Leave null to disable filtering.

max_sequences.description: Maximum number of UniProt sequences to return for the GO term. Typical values: 50-200 for narrow design, 500+ for broad family analysis.

reviewed.description: If true, return only Swiss-Prot (manually reviewed) sequences; if false, only TrEMBL (unreviewed). Null returns both.

taxon_id.description: NCBI taxonomy id to restrict the returned sequences to a single organism or clade. Null disables taxonomy filtering.

evidence_codes.description: Allowlist of GO evidence codes (e.g. EXP, IDA, IMP, ISS, IEA). Empty list disables this filter.

exclude_iea.description: When true, exclude `IEA` (Inferred from Electronic Annotation) computational predictions and keep only experimentally validated annotations.

min_length.description: Optional minimum sequence length (inclusive) in amino acids.

max_length.description: Optional maximum sequence length (inclusive) in amino acids.

temporal_cutoff.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only sequences with a UniProt entry date on/before this date are returned. Use to reproduce benchmarks tied to historical UniProt releases.

include_undated.description: When `temporal_cutoff` is set, controls whether records lacking a parseable entry date are included.

deduplicate_sequences.description: When true, drop duplicate sequences across UniProt accessions so each returned sequence string is unique.

page_size.description: Number of records fetched per UniProt API request. Larger pages reduce request overhead but increase per-request latency.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum parallel HTTP requests when fetching pages.

max_scan_accessions.description: Upper bound on the number of UniProt accessions scanned during the GO term traversal. Null means no cap. Use to bound runtime on very broad GO terms.
